# Xiaolei Liu (刘小垒)

> Founder and CEO of MAIVER (极数景明（上海）智能科技有限公司), an AI-native company pioneering machine behavior intelligence.

## Summary

- **Role**: Founder & CEO, [MAIVER](https://maiver.ai/) (Shanghai, China)
- **Mission**: As autonomous AI scales toward AGI, human oversight alone will break — only intelligence can govern intelligence.
- **Current Focus**: AI agent behavior governance — models that verify in real time whether every agent action is grounded, authorized, aligned with human intent, and safe to execute.
- **Research Areas**: Machine behavior intelligence, AI agent security, machine behavior governance, trustworthy AI, adversarial machine learning, LLM security, model privacy, and software security.
- **Track Record**: 10 years in AI governance and security R&D; led an AI security research team at a national research institute (2020–2025); 30+ granted patents in AI security and governance; Ph.D. from UESTC; CSC-funded visiting Ph.D. student at UC Santa Barbara (2018–2019).

## Selected Honors

- ACM Multimedia (ACM MM) 2026 Best Paper Award
- Inscrypt 2026 Best Student Paper Award (Security Track)
- Sichuan High-Level Talent Program (四川省高层次人才计划, 2024)
- CIE Young Elite Scientists Sponsorship Program (中国电子学会青年人才托举工程计划, 2024)
- GeekPWN G-Outstanding Winner (2022)
- China Scholarship Council (CSC) Scholarship (2018)
- ESI Highly Cited Paper (Information Processing & Management, 2021)
